analysis_decision: No v1 task-quality result is used to fit or calibrate a new gate; no automatic retry of the interrupted batch. The v2 amendment re-derives a compatible candidate from disjoint original discovery records and starts a separate checkpoint.
diagnosis: The historical registry artifact was bound to a base-condition manifest with older effect-catalog and tracer versions. The v1 runner used a compiled-condition manifest under the current runtime, so registry resolution returned no artifact on every completed episode.
